summary: Phase 1 passes acceptance at 34789e7 with four nonblocking findings. Each task has SHA evidence, and every functional requirement is in the delivered text. The three required commands and the plan's node test exit 0 at HEAD. The new test fails on the base documents and passes at HEAD. The findings are three over-long paragraphs, one wording drift, and two groups of plan record defects.
phase: Phase 1: Stop-rule text and doc test (due 2026-11-24)
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major] phase-acceptance: `skills/measure-orchestrator/references/contracts.md` lines 164, 168, and 170 hold 10, 11, and 10 sentences in one paragraph each. ASD-STE100 (global AGENTS.md section 2) allows 6 sentences in a descriptive paragraph, and lines 168 and 170 also use the conditional `would`. Rationale: the owner rule is mandatory for new prose, but the defect changes no behavior and no test pin. Split line 164 before `Two worked counts fix the count.`, line 168 before `Second, it states`, and line 170 before `When the one fix round`. Each part then holds 6 sentences or less, and both S5 tests flatten whitespace before they match. The orchestrator chooses: fix it before closeout, or record it in `measure/tech-debt.md`.

F2 [Nit] phase-acceptance: `skills/measure-orchestrator/references/contracts.md` line 168 says `Tooling, gate scripts, fixtures, logs, and records do not meet this test`. Spec FR-2 says `test tooling`, so the dropped word widens the exclusion. Rationale: this repo delivers tooling as product in many tracks, and no test pins this sentence. The sentence before it limits the bar to product files that the plan lists, and the unsure rule gives one fix round. Restore `test` before `tooling` to match FR-2.

F3 [Nit] phase-acceptance: `measure/tracks/late_finding_stop_rule_20261122/plan.md` line 22 says the rounds so far are spec review round 1 and Red round 1. This is stale, because Review A ran two rounds (1dd106c and 34789e7) and spec review ran two rounds. The result `Late finding: none` stays correct, because no round of Phase 1 reached round 3. Rationale: the plan must record late findings honestly, and this sentence lists the wrong rounds. Replace the sentence with: Phase 1 had two Review A rounds, and no round reached round 3.

F4 [Nit] phase-acceptance: `measure/tracks/late_finding_stop_rule_20261122/plan.md` holds two record defects. Task 1.2 says `No other files change`, but its SHA 081e6d2 added `tests/spec_review_gate/test_s5b_standalone.sh`. Lines 17, 19, 21, and 23 pin test, check, and suite counts, and the pins drift (24 suites at 24cf00e, 23 suites at 4bdb3d3). `skills/measure-orchestrator/SKILL.md` lines 124 to 126 forbid pinned counts and ask for a log citation. Rationale: each count carries its SHA, and I found no false count. Correct both items during closeout.

No fake-gate masking: the new tests hold no `|| true`, no exclusion option, and no skip, and they end with `exit "$FAILED"`. No stale intentional-red test remains, because all 24 suites pass. All three plan tasks are `[x]` with real SHAs (39cf9f5 and 24cf00e, 081e6d2, 4bdb3d3).

I checked the new prose in `contracts.md`, `SKILL.md`, and the four role files against ASD-STE100. Every sentence has 22 words or less, and the limit is 25. The voice is active, and noun clusters hold 3 nouns or less. Three paragraphs break the 6-sentence limit (F1).

I found no contradiction with Re-review scope or the Round limit. `contracts.md:166` keeps the Re-review scope treatment for a kept routed finding and a defect in changed lines. Line 170 says the Round limit wins and the escalation key rule stays. In round 3 or later, a re-review marks an outside-remediation finding nonblocking, while the exception gives a wrong-result finding one fix round. The text names that exception, and it follows spec FR-1 and FR-2.
